caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a long dress with long sleeves, rendered primarily in shades of white and light blue. The bodice, wrist cuffs, and the lower hem of the dress feature detailed lace patterns with floral and circular motifs highlighted in blue. The body of the dress is made of a smooth, light-colored fabric with soft shading to indicate folds and texture. The sleeves are slightly puffed at the shoulders and taper down toward the wrists, ending in lace cuffs tied with small blue ribbons. The overall composition is centered on a plain, light beige background. The artist's signature, "Edith Garner," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Doll's Dress
